artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan for the touched-path verify entry point, declarable resolver interface, and classified owed-not-paid unmapped fallback.

memory_candidates.content: suite_selection_select's union-escalation rule (one unresolvable path escalates the whole multi-path call to __FULL_SWEEP__) makes every plan that creates a NEW file resolve to the sentinel, even when the other paths in the same list map to real suites. validate-artifact.sh's Tier-Justification honesty scan inherits this: it compares a justification's named suites against the UNION result, so naming the true per-path suites for the existing files in a phase's list produces a 'fabricated claim' advisory warning that is not actually a fabrication. The honest authoring shape is to state the union sentinel first, then attribute the named suites to per-path resolution explicitly.
